fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]Er well, I don’t mind male partners, just most of what I have experience with is ladies…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Heh, I guess word gets around with the ladies here when you have… some larger assets…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Hah! Well don’t rub it in!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Well, I heard you’re… um… into bigger guys?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]Well uh… I don’t know if you wanna try… may-

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]Haha yes, please. Whatever you wanna do, yes please!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]Water is whatever, you guys had to REBUILD it!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]If the forest is going to keep growing, we’ll be needing to rebuild all sorts of stuff.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Really, it’s not a problem, and it was a matter of time anyways.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]Well… I’d still like to make it up to you somehow…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Actually, I had something else in mind…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]But I bet thats a sight to behold from you!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Yeah, I’d pay to see that!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Oh please, hah! It would be on the house, of course!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value:
Hey! Good to see you’re
talking over things.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Yeah, thanks for the push! It’s always hard for me to make the first step…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Don’t worry, I know exactly how you feel, especially with you being pretty new ’n all!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]I shoulda reached out, again, I’m sorry about that!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]Oh not at all, I still feel absolutely awful about the bridge!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Is there any way I can make it up to you?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Hah, as I’ve said, you’ve got nothing to feel bad about!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]It’s my shoddy craftsmanship that got you all wet in the first place.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value:
Speaking of which! That was
an impressive paw-free orgasm!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]It’s hard for me to climax without some sorta stimulation…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]Oh heh! Yeah, see, I don’t have any paws to help out, so I kinda had to figure out other ways of pleasing myself…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Is that a normal thing for you?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]Normally I use… ermm… well… my own mouth…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Hey Rascal! It’s good to see you

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]Gosh! You’re a wizard with that tongue! Those lips too!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Heh, thanks… They’re my main tool for pleasing critters…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Have you met Melody and Charlotte?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]The polar bear and the fox gal, right?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]But I have wanted to meet em!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=6]I’ve got a thing for big ladies, mate!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=6]See lil’ guys like myself can uh… get in pretty deep if ya know what I’m sayin.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: I think I catch your drift.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Anywho a guy can dream! For now, toss one of those cookies over!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]I gotta load up on carbs anyways, so this is perfect!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]Hey Rascal! <pause>And little Mabel! <pause>Welcome to our cave!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value:
We were wondering if you
knew a wolf from the woods?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Oooh, meeting critters isn’t really my thing you know…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]That’s much more a question for Melody!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Yeah, I’ve seen him waiting in the same spot a few times.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Hmm. <pause>Like as if he's meeting someone? <pause>He's not being sneaky, <pause>he’s not hunting, <pause>just<slow>...</slow> waiting.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]After a while he’ll move on. <pause>Maybe the critter he is waiting for shows up, <pause>I can’t really tell from where I usually am…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]My mind goes crazy wondering what he could be up to though! <pause>Maybe he’s a spy! <pause>Or maybe he’s a detective and he’s staking out a bad guy!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Or maybe he’s waiting for a hook up?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Anyways that’s all I’ve got. Sorry it’s probably not too useful…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: No worries! Thanks for your help!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]Actually, there’s something else you might be able to do for us…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]Could we borrow that jar on your shelf?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]Honestly you’d be doing me a favor! <pause>Seeing food in the jar just makes me hungry!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=6]Yeah! I used to throw a lot of parties.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Oh? I figured that wouldn’t be her thing.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]She was an absolute mess, it was adorable.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]I ended up being her party buddy, and well, I guess here we are!
